title: Taste Journey Ticket
tagline: This project aims to provide a restaurant reservation system using NFT to solve the problems associated with centralized reservation platforms.  1. Transfer reservation.  2. Use NFT as proof of attendance  3. Gourmet record 4. Enable restaurants to visualize their fans.
description: Our product is a decentralized restaurant reservation system designed to solve the problems associated with centralized reservation platforms. Traditional platforms often result in users losing their hard-earned reservations due to last-minute changes, which can lead to revenue loss for restaurants. With Gourmet Journey Ticket, we use NFTs to offer a decentralized reservation system that allows users to transfer their reservation NFTs to others. When they check in at the restaurant, their NFT is released and converted to an attendance NFT, which records their dining history on the blockchain. Meanwhile, restaurants can visualize their fanbase and provide utilities through direct connection to wallets. Our system not only centralizes fragmented dining records but also supports the vision of DID for food. Gourmet Journey Ticket aims to become a decentralized restaurant reservation system that benefits both users and restaurants, ultimately supporting the future of food.
how_its_made:
We have Next.js as our front end and thirdweb and the graph as our back end.
And we keep the system secure by inserting store information into the database and backup information into Filecoin, a distributed storage system.
Next.js is developed using the GraphQL Client Apollo and the component library Ant Design.
